items.title: Quiver 1.1.1: manage many coding agents, control them from your phone
items.summary: A command-line tool that manages multiple coding agents on one machine. Version 1.1.1 adds remote control: from a phone web page or iOS app you can watch sessions, send instructions, approve actions, interrupt or start new sessions, and a second machine can join as a satellite node. The hub binds only to your machine's Tailscale address (or loopback via tailscale serve) — no public ports. The desktop app requires macOS 26 and Apple Silicon.

items.title: Alex Relay: project-local handoffs between agents
items.summary: Alex Relay writes an agent's progress as checkpoints inside the project itself — a .alex/ folder with state.json and HANDOFF.md — so the next agent can pick up exactly where the last one stopped, without any vendor chat history and without a cloud service. Public alpha; repository created October 23, 2026.
